name: Morse.IsCellAttachment
hypotheses: Up to homeomorphism of K: T K cells ⟺ ∃ K', P K' cells ∧ Nonempty (K' ≅ K). P ⇒ T outright.
difference: The project's predicate depends on the literal TopCat object (iterated pushouts from PEmpty); the blind one is closed under homeomorphism. No separating K can be exhibited in Lean, since that would require refuting an equality between types of the same cardinality. Order conventions agree: the listed order, head first, each cell along any continuous map into the space built so far.
why: Proved P_imp_T, and agree identifies the blind notion as the homeomorphism closure of the project's, using the shared glue (Quot adjunction space ≅ pushout, base-change of pushouts, snoc/unsnoc). The project uses IsCellAttachment only inside ∃ K, IsCellAttachment K cells ∧ (X ≃ₕ K) and in conclusions, where the rigidity costs nothing.
